name: Azrith
trait: Azrith döyüş meydanında sağ qaldığı və öz qalxanıqırılmadığı müddətcə ətrafındakı bütün dost kartlara +10% hasar bonusu təmin edər. Düşmən hücumları nəticəsində onun qalxanı qırıldıqda, Azrith geri çəkilmir və olduğu koordinata müqəddəs bir "Bannerox" sancar.
story: Aza is the brilliant and courageous commander who leads the royal army from the front. Her golden armor shines with authority, complemented by a striking red cloak that flows behind her like a river of blood. In her right hand, she wields a sword of legendary status, while her left hand grips a massive red flag. This banner is more than a symbol; it is said to grant her supernatural strength. She is a scholar of war, guiding her troops with both unmatched intellect and fearless power.

forms.name: Bannerox
forms.trait: Meydanda qalan bu bayraq strateji bir nöqtə rolunu oynayır və onun yaxınlığındakı bütün dost kartlara +10% hücum sürəti bonusu bəxş edərək ordunun döyüş əzmini artırar.

name: Untouch
trait: Bu dözümlü döyüşçünün canı hər 20% azaldıqda o, bədənini qoruyan xüsusi bir fazaya keçər və 2 saniyəlik tam toxunulmazlıq statusu qazanar. Bu toxunulmazlıq müddəti bitdikdən sonra edəcəyi ilk vuruşu rəqibə əlavə +20% hasar yetirər. Bu qabiliyyət onu kritik anlarda həm qoruyur, həm də əks-hücum üçün gücləndirir.
story: UnTouch is the younger sister of Aza, but her power is legendary throughout the kingdom. She wears heavy, golden armor and carries a pair of specialized golden gauntlets on both hands. When she strikes the earth with these gauntlets, she triggers massive earthquakes that can split mountains in two. Despite her overwhelming physical strength, her heart beats for her people, and she fights to protect their homes from any threat. She is the kingdom's ultimate force of nature, a girl whose kindness is as deep as her strikes are shattering.

name: Heartix
trait: Hər 40 saniyədə qarşıdakı rəqibi 20 saniyəlik öz tərəfinə çəkər

name: R-1
trait: Atışları qalxandan keçər, "İnsan" tipli kartlara -50% daha az hasar verər
story: The Radioactive Automaton, an advanced four-wheeled combat robot secretly engineered by an unknown genius inventor of the Steam Alliance. Built using the pinnacle of industrial-era technology, R-1 represents the perfect fusion of precision engineering, steam-powered mechanics, and experimental radioactive energy. Every component of the machine has been optimized for overwhelming firepower and battlefield efficiency. R-1 is a heavily armored four-wheeled combat automaton, featuring a robust chassis constructed from forged steel, polished brass, reinforced iron plating, copper piping, and intricate mechanical assemblies. The vehicle rides on four massive reinforced industrial wheels, allowing exceptional mobility across rough terrain while maintaining a low, stable profile. At the center of its body lies a highly protected radioactive reactor core, visible through reinforced glass containment chambers and heavy armored vents. The reactor emits a brilliant emerald-green glow, illuminating the surrounding machinery from within. Mechanical cooling systems, pressure valves, rotating turbines, and warning indicators surround the reactor, emphasizing the dangerous energy contained inside. Mounted on the front of the robot is a high-powered energy cannon equipped with three focusing emitters capable of releasing three consecutive devastating energy beams. The cannon is composed of precision-machined metal rings, electromagnetic coils, rotating focusing lenses, and heavy cooling mechanisms. During charging, glowing green energy flows through exposed conduits across the robot's chassis, converging toward the cannon as arcs of contained energy dance between mechanical components. Steam escapes from numerous exhaust vents while gears, pistons, and mechanical actuators operate continuously to stabilize the reactor. Small warning lights and rotating gauges indicate that enormous power is building inside the machine before its devastating attack. The battlefield is an enormous industrial complex filled with towering steam engines, massive gears, steel bridges, copper pipelines, pressure boilers, and colossal factories. Volumetric steam drifts through the environment while sparks, glowing furnaces, and industrial lighting create a dramatic atmosphere. The charging energy from R-1 reflects across polished metal surfaces, emphasizing its technological superiority. The overall design should feel like high-end steampunk technology, combining Victorian industrial engineering with advanced experimental science rather than futuristic cyberpunk aesthetics. R-1 should appear intimidating, sophisticated, and engineered with absolute precision.

name: Blank
trait: Hər rəqib kart öldürdükdə +1 Hasar bonusu (Max: 5)
story: The Endless Null, the most terrifying entity of the Dark Layer in Alien World: The Binary Divide. Unlike every other alien, Blank possesses no true physical form. It is a living absence—a cosmic anomaly that erases existence itself. Wherever Blank appears, light vanishes, memories fade, colors lose their meaning, and reality begins to collapse into absolute nothingness. It does not kill through violence; it simply removes everything from existence. Blank manifests as a humanoid silhouette composed entirely of living darkness, with no visible skin, armor, or biological features. Its body appears to be an endless void that absorbs all surrounding light, making it impossible to determine where its form truly begins or ends. The edges of its silhouette constantly dissolve into drifting black particles and shadow-like smoke. Its face is almost featureless. Instead of eyes, there are two deep glowing white voids that radiate an unnatural, emotionless gaze. The rest of the face remains hidden beneath shifting darkness, occasionally revealing impossible distortions that immediately disappear again. Looking directly at Blank creates the sensation that reality itself is breaking apart. Its arms and hands stretch unnaturally, fading into black mist toward the fingertips. Small fragments of darkness continuously detach from its body before dissolving into nothingness. Around its hands, floating pieces of shattered reality, broken light, and fragmented space orbit silently before being consumed by the void. The entire area surrounding Blank is engulfed in an enormous sphere of absolute darkness. Light bends unnaturally toward the entity before disappearing completely. Stars, glowing particles, and even reflections are swallowed by the surrounding void. The darkness feels infinitely deep, as though it leads directly into another dimension. The battlefield itself is collapsing. Alien ruins, mountains, floating rocks, and technological structures break apart into black geometric fragments before dissolving into emptiness. Portions of the landscape simply cease to exist, leaving impossible holes where reality has been erased. The sky above is filled with fractured space-time anomalies, shattered stars, gravitational distortions, and enormous cracks in reality revealing an endless black cosmic abyss beyond the universe itself. Strange gravitational waves warp the environment, bending light and space around Blank. The atmosphere is silent, cold, and unsettling. Black mist, floating ash-like particles, distorted gravitational lensing, and subtle white energy fragments drift through the void. Every visual element should communicate cosmic horror rather than traditional darkness. Blank stands completely motionless in the center of the collapsing battlefield. It does not appear aggressive—it simply exists, and reality dies around it. The overall composition should portray Blank as an incomprehensible cosmic entity beyond life, death, matter, or energy—the physical embodiment of absolute nothingness.

name: Magmara
trait: Rəqib kartlara ekstra 3x10 Yanma Hasarı verər
story: The Molten Matriarch, the supreme ruler of the Dark Layer of Alien World: The Binary Divide, an ancient alien queen born from the planet's molten core. She is the embodiment of planetary destruction, commanding oceans of magma and volcanic fury. Entire civilizations vanish beneath her wrath as she reshapes continents with rivers of living lava. Every eruption on the planet is merely an extension of her will. Magmara is a towering, regal alien female with an intimidating yet elegant appearance. Her body is composed of dark volcanic obsidian covered with glowing crimson-orange magma veins that pulse like molten blood beneath her rocky skin. Cracks across her body reveal intense lava flowing underneath, radiating immense heat. Her face is majestic and fearsome, featuring sharp alien facial structures, glowing molten-orange eyes without visible pupils, and an expression of absolute authority. A magnificent crown-like formation of volcanic crystal and obsidian horns grows naturally from her head, resembling cooled lava spikes emerging from an active volcano. She wears naturally formed volcanic armor rather than manufactured clothing. Jagged obsidian plates cover parts of her body while streams of molten lava flow between the armor's fractures. Her shoulders and back are adorned with massive volcanic crystal formations glowing with internal heat. Both hands manipulate enormous spheres and streams of molten magma. Lava coils around her arms like living serpents before crashing into the ground as explosive rivers of fire. Floating volcanic rocks orbit around her, suspended by immense planetary energy. Every movement causes lava droplets, sparks, ash, and molten debris to erupt into the surrounding air. Behind her rises a gigantic volcanic landscape filled with erupting supervolcanoes, flowing lava rivers, collapsing mountains, burning craters, black volcanic cliffs, and ash-filled skies. Massive lava waterfalls pour into glowing magma oceans while volcanic lightning flashes through towering clouds of smoke and ash. The ground beneath her fractures with glowing cracks, releasing molten energy from deep beneath the planet's crust. Heat distortion warps the surrounding air, while embers, smoke, volcanic ash, and burning debris fill the atmosphere. The environment feels apocalyptic, as if the planet itself obeys her commands. The overall composition should portray Magmara as the unquestioned queen of destruction—majestic, unstoppable, and terrifyingly beautiful. She is not merely controlling lava; she is the living heart of the planet's molten core.

name: Willowshade
trait: Vuruşları qalxandan keçər, öləndə "Octarion"-a dönüşər
story: The Abyssal Elf, a mesmerizing high elf from the same hidden botanical realm as Sylviana, yet drawn toward the mysterious depths of ancient oceans rather than blooming gardens. She embodies the beauty, elegance, and unpredictability of the sea, merging elven grace with abyssal marine power. Willowshade possesses long, flowing hair with deep ocean-inspired hues, blending dark blue, teal, and subtle violet tones. Her delicate elven features and pointed ears remain unmistakably noble, but her appearance carries an enigmatic aura unlike the warmth of her sister. Her eyes glow with the colors of deep ocean waters, reflecting intelligence, curiosity, and hidden power. She wears an elegant fantasy outfit inspired by marine life and elven nobility. Flowing fabrics resemble moving water, while intricate patterns evoke coral structures, ocean currents, and the graceful forms of sea creatures. Decorative elements inspired by octopuses subtly appear throughout her attire, including tentacle-like embroidery, organic curves, and aquatic motifs that feel sophisticated rather than monstrous. Around her swirl beautiful currents of magical water suspended in midair. The water forms elegant spirals, floating droplets, and fluid ribbons that continuously move around her body. Emerging from these currents are translucent spectral tentacles composed entirely of glowing oceanic energy. These ethereal appendages move gracefully through the air like living currents, creating a striking and mystical visual effect. Several small luminous sea creatures made of magical water swim through the floating currents around her. Tiny jellyfish-like spirits, glowing fish, and aquatic particles enhance the oceanic atmosphere. Her presence feels adaptable, intelligent, and endlessly fluid, much like the creatures she admires. The environment combines elven beauty with abyssal mystery. Behind her lies a breathtaking coastal sanctuary where ancient elven architecture merges with crystal-clear waters, glowing coral formations, bioluminescent marine plants, and hidden underwater ruins visible through magical portals. Moonlight reflects across the water, creating a dreamlike and enchanting atmosphere. The overall composition should emphasize elegance, mystery, and oceanic magic rather than darkness or horror. Willowshade appears as a graceful master of the sea's hidden wonders, commanding the beauty and power of marine life through refined elven magic.

forms.name: Octarion
forms.trait: Ölən zaman olduğu yerə 3x5 Zəhər hasarı verər

name: Collector
trait: Öldürdüyü hər rəqib kart üçün +2 Mana qazanar

name: Sushu
trait: Görünməz olar, rəqibin içinə girərək öləndə qədər hasar verər
story: Sushu is a tiny female ghost girl wandering through an abandoned Wild West ghost town. She appears small, adorable, and innocent at first glance, but her personality is completely different—she is constantly irritated, grumpy, and visibly angry. Despite her cute appearance, her sharp supernatural perception allows her to detect hidden targets throughout the ghost town, even when they are concealed in darkness, abandoned buildings, or heavy dust. Sushu has a small, delicate childlike body with realistic human proportions for her tiny size. Her skin is extremely pale and slightly translucent, with a subtle cold bluish spectral glow. Her lower body gradually dissolves into thin wisps of ghostly mist instead of having fully solid legs, clearly showing that she is a spirit. Her face is adorable but permanently annoyed. She has large, realistic expressive eyes with a faint pale-blue supernatural glow, furrowed eyebrows, slightly narrowed eyes, and a small irritated expression. Her messy dark hair falls around her face and moves subtly as if affected by an invisible supernatural breeze. She wears an old, simple dark Victorian-style dress, slightly oversized for her tiny body, with worn fabric, small tears, faded details, and dusty edges. The clothing should look authentic to an old Western ghost town rather than modern. In her hands, Sushu holds a small stuffed fox toy. The toy is old, heavily damaged, and visibly torn apart. Its fabric is ripped in several places, exposing cotton stuffing and internal threads. One ear is partially detached, several stitches have come undone, and patches of its fur are missing. Despite its damaged condition, Sushu holds the toy protectively as if it is extremely important to her. The toy should look like a real, handmade childhood plush toy, with faded orange-brown fabric, worn black button eyes, and a small damaged tail. It must look physically realistic and heavily aged, not magical or cartoonish. Sushu stands alone in the center of an abandoned ghost town. Old wooden saloons, collapsed buildings, broken wagons, rusty signs, abandoned barrels, cracked fences, and empty streets surround her. The town is silent and forgotten, with weeds growing through the dusty ground. Her supernatural tracking ability is represented subtly through her eyes and surroundings: faint translucent spectral traces appear in the distance, barely visible silhouettes and energy disturbances revealing hidden targets behind walls and abandoned structures. These effects should remain subtle and realistic rather than looking like exaggerated magic. A cold mist surrounds Sushu's small body, especially around her feet, while tiny spectral particles drift through the air. Her ghostly presence slightly distorts the atmosphere around her. The lighting is dark, cinematic, and realistic, with a cloudy night sky, faint moonlight illuminating the abandoned street, and a few old lanterns producing weak warm light in the distance. Strong contrast between cold moonlight and dim lantern light creates an eerie supernatural atmosphere. Sushu should be positioned centrally, staring directly toward the viewer with an extremely annoyed expression, gripping the damaged fox plush tightly in both hands. Her tiny size should contrast strongly with the enormous, empty ghost town surrounding her.

name: Umbra
trait: Canı 75% olduqda 3 saniyəlik görünməz olar, 50% olduqda 7,500 Karo geriyə gedər
story: The Twilight Warden, a mysterious female alien guardian who watches over the border between light and darkness in Alien World: The Binary Divide. Unlike the warriors of either faction, Umbra commands the ancient power of twilight—the perfect balance between light and shadow. She manipulates living shadows not to spread fear, but to protect the innocent and imprison the darkness before it can consume the world. Her presence is silent, graceful, and almost supernatural, making her one of the most enigmatic protectors of the Light Layer. Umbra is a tall, elegant female alien with a slender yet athletic physique. Her smooth skin fades seamlessly from luminous pearl-white into deep violet and midnight black, creating a natural twilight gradient across her body. Delicate glowing indigo energy veins flow beneath her skin like rivers of starlight. Her face is beautiful, calm, and mysterious, with graceful alien features and glowing violet eyes that seem to contain entire galaxies. Her expression is gentle yet unreadable, radiating wisdom, serenity, and quiet authority. Long flowing hair transitions from silver-white near the crown into deep violet and finally black at the tips, floating weightlessly around her. She wears living twilight crystal armor, organically grown from rare celestial minerals. The armor combines translucent white crystal with deep violet obsidian-like crystal, creating a perfect harmony between light and shadow. Elegant crystalline shoulder pieces, forearm guards, and leg armor emit a soft violet glow, while flowing shadow-like energy ribbons drift behind her like an ethereal cloak. Around Umbra orbit several floating shadow crystals, suspended effortlessly in the air. These crystalline shards emit faint violet light while releasing streams of living shadow that swirl gracefully around her without appearing evil or corrupted. Both of her hands command powerful twilight energy. One hand creates glowing violet shadow ribbons that form elegant protective barriers, while the other shapes luminous white energy capable of purifying corruption. Between her hands, both energies merge into a mesmerizing sphere of balanced cosmic power. Behind Umbra floats an enormous crescent-shaped twilight halo, formed from intertwined rings of radiant white light and deep violet shadow energy. Small stars, glowing particles, and fragments of cosmic dust slowly orbit within the halo, reinforcing her role as guardian of the boundary between day and night. The battlefield lies within the sacred Twilight Zone, where the Light Layer meets the edge of darkness. Crystal forests glow beneath an eternal sunset, while floating islands drift across a sky painted with brilliant shades of gold, lavender, indigo, and deep blue. Giant luminous trees, glowing flowers, crystal rivers, and distant celestial mountains create an environment that feels magical and peaceful. Soft twilight mist flows across the ground while luminous butterflies, floating stardust, and glowing flower petals drift gently through the air. Long beams of warm sunset light blend naturally with cool violet shadows, creating breathtaking cinematic contrast. Umbra gracefully hovers just above the ground, one hand extending protective shadow magic while the other radiates gentle celestial light. Her posture is elegant, composed, and protective, symbolizing harmony rather than conflict. The overall composition should portray Umbra as the divine guardian of twilight—a celestial female alien whose mastery of balanced light and shadow protects the universe from falling into eternal darkness.

name: Thief
trait: 15,000 Karo qabaqdakı ilk rəqibin özəlliyini oğurlayar
story: The Silent Hand, a cunning and elusive bandit roaming the abandoned streets of The Ghost Town. Unlike ordinary outlaws who rely on brute force, Thief survives through speed, deception, and extraordinary sleight of hand. He silently approaches distracted enemies and steals their ammunition, supplies, and valuable equipment directly from them before disappearing into the shadows. Thief is a lean, agile adult male bandit with a lightweight physique built for speed, stealth, and quick movements. His face is partially concealed by a dark cloth covering his lower face, leaving only his sharp, observant eyes visible. His expression is constantly alert and calculating, always searching for the next opportunity. He wears a dark, practical Western bandit outfit designed for silent movement: a faded black-brown long coat, dark shirt, fitted trousers, worn leather boots, and soft leather gloves. His clothing is dusty and weathered from years spent moving between abandoned settlements. A wide-brimmed, slightly battered cowboy hat casts a deep shadow over his face, making him difficult to identify in low light. Several small leather pouches and hidden compartments are attached to his belt, specifically designed for storing stolen ammunition, coins, tools, and supplies. His hands are the most important part of his appearance. He wears thin, flexible leather gloves that allow precise movements and exceptional dexterity. One hand is reaching silently toward an enemy's ammunition belt, while the other already holds several stolen bullets between his fingers. Around his waist are multiple stolen ammunition pouches, some visibly belonging to different enemies, showing that he constantly collects supplies during battle. A small leather satchel hangs across his body, partially open and filled with stolen ammunition, medicine bottles, tools, and other battlefield supplies. Thief carries only a small concealed utility knife, kept inside his coat for emergencies rather than direct combat. His primary weapon is his ability to steal and escape before his enemies realize what happened. The environment is a narrow section of The Ghost Town, filled with abandoned wooden buildings, dark alleys, broken fences, old wagons, dusty streets, and forgotten supply crates. Several abandoned shops and storage buildings create countless hiding places. Thief is positioned partially behind a wooden structure, almost completely hidden in shadow. He moves silently toward an unaware enemy, carefully removing an ammunition pouch without making a sound. His body is low and balanced, emphasizing his stealth and agility. Small details tell the story of his profession: discarded ammunition boxes, opened supply crates, loose bullets scattered across a wooden table, and empty holsters left behind by previous victims. The lighting is dramatic and atmospheric. Late-evening sunlight filters between the abandoned buildings while deep shadows cover the narrow alleys. Dust particles float through the golden light, creating a cinematic contrast between illuminated streets and dark hiding places. The overall composition should portray Thief as a clever, silent opportunist who turns enemy resources against them, stealing their ability to fight rather than confronting them directly.

name: Rotlings
trait: Hər ölən rəqib kart üçün +1 Hasar bonusu
story: A swarm of Rotlings, horrifying decaying zombies from beyond reality, advancing across a ruined dimensional wasteland. Their rotting bodies are completely entangled in twisted roots, corrupted vines, fungal growths, and cosmic filth. Flesh appears partially decomposed, with ancient roots piercing through bones and limbs, creating unnatural and disturbing forms. Every Rotling looks different, yet all share the same plague-like corruption and relentless hunger. The creatures move together as a spreading infestation, multiplying endlessly as they advance. Wherever they pass, the ground decays into blackened wasteland. Reality itself appears corrupted around them, with cracks, dead vegetation, corrupted soil, and fragments of collapsing dimensions scattered throughout the environment. Thick clouds of dark spores, dust, and corruption drift through the air. Some Rotlings crawl on all fours while others stagger forward in twisted humanoid shapes. Their bodies are covered with tangled roots, thorny growths, parasitic plants, and layers of cosmic decay. Their glowing eyes reflect endless hunger and mindless devotion to destruction. The swarm stretches into the distance, emphasizing their overwhelming numbers and unstoppable spread. Above them, faint silhouettes of flying creatures can be seen in the sky, causing visible unease within the horde. Several Rotlings instinctively look upward in fear, reinforcing their only known weakness. The contrast between their confidence on the ground and their fear of aerial threats adds tension to the scene.

name: Stormblade
trait: Hasarı yaxındakı rəqiblərə sıçrayar
story: The Tempest Executioner, one of the deadliest warriors of the Dark Layer in Alien World: The Binary Divide. A relentless alien speedster born beneath endless planetary superstorms, Stormblade transforms lightning into a weapon of absolute destruction. Every movement generates violent electrical discharges, allowing this merciless hunter to strike faster than the eye can follow. Victims rarely see Stormblade—they only witness flashes of lightning before everything goes dark. Stormblade is a tall, athletic alien warrior with a sleek, aerodynamic body built entirely for speed. Its armor is formed from dark obsidian-like alien alloy, featuring razor-sharp edges and smooth organic curves that reduce air resistance. Thin glowing veins of electric blue and violet energy race beneath the armor like living lightning, constantly pulsing across its body. Its helmet-like head has an aggressive, angular design with two piercing electric-blue eyes that radiate pure energy. Sharp horn-like energy conductors extend backward from the head, continuously attracting arcs of planetary lightning. Small bolts of electricity jump between the horns and surrounding air. Mounted on both forearms are dual plasma blades, each formed from condensed high-voltage energy contained within advanced alien emitters. The blades glow with brilliant blue-white plasma, surrounded by violent electrical arcs and streams of ionized energy. They appear impossibly sharp, capable of slicing through armored targets in a single high-speed strike. Stormblade's limbs are exceptionally lean and powerful, designed for explosive acceleration. Along its legs and back are streamlined energy conduits and electromagnetic propulsion vents that release bursts of blue plasma whenever it changes direction. Trails of crackling electricity remain suspended in the air behind every movement. The battlefield is a hostile alien wasteland beneath an enormous planetary electrical storm. Towering black rock formations, shattered alien structures, floating metallic debris, and enormous crystalline energy conductors surround the battlefield. Above, massive thunderclouds churn continuously while colossal bolts of blue lightning strike the landscape. Electricity constantly dances across the ground around Stormblade's feet, creating glowing fractures and ionized scorch marks. Floating rocks levitate as electromagnetic energy distorts gravity nearby. The atmosphere is filled with blue plasma particles, sparks, ozone mist, and swirling storm winds. Stormblade stands in an aggressive combat stance, one plasma blade held low and the other raised, while lightning repeatedly crashes directly into its body without causing any damage. The electrical energy is visibly absorbed into its armor, making the glowing energy veins intensify with every strike. The overall composition should portray Stormblade as the living embodiment of a planetary thunderstorm—merciless, impossibly fast, and overwhelmingly powerful.

name: Venom Fangs
trait: Vuruşları ekstra 3x1 hasar verər və rəqib kartdan +0,5% Kritik Şansı oğurlayar

name: Skyhunter
trait: Skyhunter rəqibləri ilə arasındakı məsafəni öz xeyrinə istifadə edən peşəkar bir ovçudur. O, hədəf aldığı rəqib kart ilə öz arasındakı hər karo üçün +10% hasar bonusu qazanar. Rəqib ondan nə qədər uzaq olarsa, Skyhunter-in oxları bir o qədər dağıdıcı gücə sahib olur. Bu xüsusiyyət onu arxa cəbhədən düşmənin əsas qüvvələrini zərərsizləşdirmək üçün mükəmməl bir uzaq məsafəli karta çevirir.
story: SkyHunter is a veteran warrior of immense talent, serving as the kingdom's silent guardian from above. Clad in golden armor designed for stealth, he is a master of invisibility who believes that being seen is a failure. He uses a custom-built weapon specifically engineered to obliterate any flying creature or threat within seconds. Stealth is his primary tool; he moves through the shadows of the clouds, ensuring that the skies remain clear for the Royal Blood. He is the unseen predator that enemies never hear coming until it is too late.

name: Rockback
trait: Rockback rəqib karta doğru irəliləyərkən böyük bir impuls yığar və hədəfə yaxınlaşana qədər +50% sürət qazanar. Bu sürətlə etdiyi ilk vuruşu düşmənə əlavə +150% hasar vurar. Üstəlik, onun qoruyucu qalxanı qırıldıqdan sonrakı 6 saniyə ərzində etdiyi hər bir vuruş ona +10 Qalxan bərpa edər.
story: Once a peaceful armadillo living quietly in the savanna, Rockback was kidnapped and subjected to Henry's most painful mutations. His natural armor has been fused with metallic minerals, making his shell virtually indestructible. He is no longer a shy creature; he is a living tank. When he rolls into a ball, he becomes a crushing boulder that flattens anything in his path. Rockback is a tragic masterpiece—a gentle soul trapped inside a jagged, unstoppable weapon of war.

name: Neon Droid
trait: Hasar verdikcə 3 saniyəlik +20% Saldırı Hızı qazanar (Max: 60%)
story: Neon Droid floats through the dark caverns as the ultimate security asset for the Constructs. From a distance, this sleek guardian resembles a metallic, floating ball gliding silently through the air. Do not let its shape fool you; despite having only a single central eye, its advanced sensors see absolutely everything, leaving no blind spots for intruders. It scans the shadows constantly, ready to eliminate any threat to the facility with mechanical precision.

name: Void Wraith
trait: Ətrafındakı rəqib kartların hasarlarının 20%-ni özünə çəkər (Max: 16)
story: Void Wraith, an ancient interdimensional phantom emerging from a realm where time does not exist. The entity floats silently above the ground, existing outside the laws of reality. Its form is ghostly and incomprehensible, appearing as a dark spectral figure composed of living void energy, cosmic shadows, and fragments of broken space. Its body is partially transparent, with portions dissolving into darkness and drifting into the surrounding void. A terrifying aura surrounds the Void Wraith, constantly pulling energy from everything nearby. Streams of luminous life essence flow from the environment toward the phantom, spiraling around its body before being absorbed into its core. The stolen energy forms glowing currents that orbit the entity like celestial rivers being consumed by an endless abyss. The closer objects are to the Wraith, the more drained and lifeless they appear. Its face is hidden beneath layers of darkness, revealing only faint glowing eyes deep within the void. Fragments of shattered reality float around it—broken stones, pieces of ancient structures, and distorted particles suspended in impossible positions as if time itself has ceased to function. The air around the entity appears warped and unstable, creating subtle gravitational distortions. The environment resembles a place beyond time and existence, with fractured dimensions, cosmic darkness, and endless emptiness stretching into the distance. Wisps of dark energy, spectral fog, and dimensional anomalies surround the Wraith, emphasizing its nature as a being detached from all eras and realities. The overall atmosphere is eerie, mysterious, and overwhelming. The Void Wraith appears less like a creature and more like a living manifestation of entropy and consumption, silently draining all life and energy in its presence.

name: Bio Mech
trait: Hər hasar aldıqda ətrafdakı kartlar +1% Qalxan qazanar

name: Mixela
trait: 3x3 Yaxınında ölən kartların canlarının 60%-ni özünə qatar

name: Laura
trait: Laura hər saniyə +8 yük qazanar. 100 yükə çatdıqda daxili enerjisini sərbəst buraxaraq ətrafa enerji dalğası yayar, Bu enerji dalğası ətrafındakı bütün dost kartların statistikalarını (hücum, müdafiə, sürət) +25% artırar.
story: Laura has dedicated her life to the art of healing, focusing her magical energy on mending wounds and restoring life. Raised and educated by the Chrono Mage, she views the world with a patient, timeless perspective. She moves through the battlefield as a beacon of restoration, shielding her allies from the brink of death. Despite her immense power, she refuses to use it for harm, believing that her true purpose is to preserve the fragile balance of life around her.
